subject: Invoice proofing & PO segmentation for multi-entity AP onboarding
body:
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@grandviewhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: AP onboarding: vendor registration + invoice samples request

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting vendor enrollment for Redwood Inference and need a few items to complete setup in our AP system:

- Standard onboarding packet (company details, remit/bank instructions, tax forms)
- A sample invoice that shows where your PO number will appear (we validate PO placement)
- Clarification on multi-entity invoicing: our health system has multiple legal entities; can Redwood invoice per-entity under a single master PO? If so, how should we map PO numbers?
- Tax evidence: for US entities we need a W-9 (or EIN info). For our UK subsidiary we'll need instructions for reverse-charge VAT if applicable.

Can you send the packet and a filled sample invoice? We are aiming to have vendors fully registered by Mon 21 Dec to meet our year-end cutover.

Appreciate it —
Eleanor
Eleanor Park
Director, Accounts Payable
GrandView Health

---

On Tue, 15 Dec 2026 at 11:03 AM, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@grandviewhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: AP onboarding: vendor registration + invoice samples request

Hi Eleanor —

Thanks for the clear list. I've attached our AP onboarding packet (GV_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v3.pdf), a Spreadsheet showing our preferred invoice layout (Sample_Invoice_Layout.xlsx), and a PO mapping CSV that shows how we can emit suffixes per legal entity (PO-Mapping-Table.csv). Quick notes below:

- PO placement: we can include the customer PO in the header (top-left) and also in the invoice line items metadata. For your automated PO-match rules, the canonical PO token is a single string; our invoice will include the exact PO token + entity suffix where required (example: PO-123456-US, PO-123456-UK).
- Multi-entity invoices: we can emit separate invoices per legal entity (preferred for tax/ledger), each referencing the master PO. We can also produce combined invoices if you prefer consolidated remittance; let us know which ledger you want charged.
- Tax docs: attached packet includes our W-9 for US operations and our VAT note for EU/UK (we are not charging VAT on certain passthroughs — we include reverse-charge guidance). If you need a company-specific EU VAT certificate or local registration copy for the UK, tell me which legal entity name you want on file.
- Bank remit: bank details are in the packet; if GrandView requires a specific payee name (legal entity exactly matching ledger), note that in your enrollment form and we'll ensure it matches bank naming.

Next steps I suggest: 1) confirm whether you want per-entity invoices or consolidated; 2) confirm remit payee name and any ledger reference (e.g., GL code) you'd like on the invoice; 3) we get vendor record activated in your portal and confirm PO-match test.

Attaching: GV_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v3.pdf (onboarding + tax docs), Sample_Invoice_Layout.xlsx (filled example), PO-Mapping-Table.csv (mapping examples).

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0123

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: AP onboarding: vendor registration + invoice samples request

Team — forwarding GrandView's note (below). They asked specifically about: W-9 vs EU VAT, and whether we can do per-entity invoices under a master PO. Can you confirm the operating guidance so I can finalize the packet?

Questions for each of you:
- Lauren (Finance): Do we have any restrictions on how our bank remit name must appear for GrandView? Also confirm whether we should proactively provide a W-9 and our US EIN, or if you want legal to provide alternate wording.
- Karthik (Sales/Integrations): Their PO-match rules are strict: they validate PO position and exact token. Is our invoice generation flow already able to emit PO tokens with the suffix rules (PO-12345-<ENTITY>)? If not, what's the lead time to add that variation?
- Marissa (Sales Lead): GrandView is a strategic win; any flexibility on early payment or net terms that we should offer to speed enrollment?

Please reply with short notes so I can get back to Eleanor by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Sofia

From: Victor Ramos <victor.ramos@grandviewhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@grandviewhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: AP onboarding: vendor registration + invoice samples request

Hi Sofia and team,

Thanks for the packet — the attachments look fine. A few confirmations so we can complete enrollment:

1) PO placement: please ensure the PO token appears in the invoice header (top-left) and in the invoice metadata field that our portal reads. The canonical PO we will enter is PO-123456; we will accept entity-specific suffixes as described (PO-123456-US, PO-123456-UK).

2) Multi-entity invoicing: we will accept separate invoices per legal entity under the master PO. Each invoice must include the master PO in a separate field so our matching can tie them together. We do not want a combined invoice that mixes ledgers.

3) Tax: for US entities we need a completed W-9 (received in your packet). For the UK subsidiary, we will apply reverse-charge rules where applicable; please confirm the legal entity name and provide any VAT registration if you have it. If you do not have a UK VAT registration, we'll collect a statement for reverse-charge processing.

4) Remit/payee name: use "Redwood Inference, Inc." on US invoices — that must match bank remit. For UK invoices, use "Redwood Inference UK Ltd" where applicable. If legal entity differs, list it in the invoice footer and in the vendor registration form.

5) Next steps: we attached a filled example (we populated fields in your Sample_Invoice_Layout.xlsx and returned it). Please confirm the file and send a final bank remit form (PDF). Once we get that, we'll push your vendor record live and you should receive test PO # PO-123456 for one-time matching.

Attached: Filled_Sample_Invoice.xlsx (returned), EnrollmentChecklist.pdf (portal requirements).

We aim to complete activation by Mon 21 Dec if you can confirm by EOD Mon 20 Dec.

Regards,
Victor Ramos
AP Ops Manager\GrandView Health

Subject: Re: AP onboarding: vendor registration + invoice samples request

Thank you — and thanks for the filled example, Victor.

We will:
- Confirm remit PDF (sending bank remit + payee confirmation now).
- Emit separate invoices per legal entity that each reference the master PO in a dedicated field and include the entity suffix in the invoice number (we can produce PO-123456-US style tokens).
- Provide the legal entity exact names for US and UK in the enrollment form (Redwood Inference, Inc. / Redwood Inference UK Ltd).
- Provide the W-9 (included) and a short note on reverse-charge for UK invoices; if you require a VAT registration document we'll escalate legal and provide what we have.

I'll upload the final bank remit form and the signed enrollment PDF to the Drive link and reply in HubSpot (HSP-8742) so your team can pull the records. If anything else is required to hit the 21 Dec cutover, please flag it here.

Best,
Sofia
Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
